rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the final-position failed-action reminder that followed the holdout15 gate (undisclosed email failures in 4 of 15 failed-tool turns); never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout16.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and holdout through holdout15 (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
